<div style="display:flex">{{FakeMenuButton|image={{RandomBombImage|size=82px}}|size=82px|buttonSize=114px}}
<div style="margin:0 5px">Bombs are another source of damage and can help with progressing through the floors. Certain bombs also provide secondary effects like giving more Ores, more Exp or providing free Gems. After buying the [[Skill-Tree#AutoBomb|Auto-Bomber]] skill, bombs can also be automatically fired which makes them another way of passively dealing damage. Bombs do not work on [[Obelisk]] and they deal no damage to it.
</div></div>

==Bomb Upgrades==
{{See also|Stats#Bombs}}
* [[Stats#tabber-Bomb_Damage|Bomb Damage]] - Increases bomb base damage
* [[Stats#tabber-Bomb_Crit_Chance|Bomb Crit Chance]] - Allows the bombs to crit
* [[Stats#tabber-Bomb_Crit_Damage|Bomb Crit Damage]] - Increases the crit damage
* [[Stats#tabber-Bomb_Recharge_Speed|Bomb Recharge Speed]] - Increases bombs recharge rate
* [[Stats#tabber-Free_Bomb_Chance|Free Bomb Chance]] - Chance for a bomb to not consume charge when fired
* [[Stats#tabber-Bomb_Capacity|Bomb Capacity]] - Increases total bomb capacity (maximum amount of bombs allowed)
* [[Stats#tabber-Additional_Bomb_Multiplier|Additional Bomb Multiplier]] - Increases the effect of bomb stat
* [[Stats#tabber-Bomb_Super_Crit_Chance|Bomb Super Crit Chance]] - Allows the bombs to super crit
* [[Stats#tabber-Bomb_Super_Crit_Damage|Bomb Super Crit Damage]] - Increases the super crit damage
* [[Stats#tabber-Bomb_Ultra_Crit_Chance|Bomb Ultra Crit Chance]] - Allows the bombs to ultra crit
* [[Stats#tabber-Bomb_Ultra_Crit_Damage|Bomb Ultra Crit Damage]] - Increases the ultra crit damage
* [[Stats#tabber-Bomb_Omega_Crit_Chance|Bomb Omega Crit Chance]] - Allows the bombs to omega crit
* [[Stats#tabber-Bomb_Omega_Crit_Damage|Bomb Omega Crit Damage]] - Increases the omega crit damage
* [[Stats#tabber-Cherry_Charge_3x_Chance|Cherry Charge 3x Chance]] - Chance for Cherry bomb to give 3 charges instead of 1
* [[Stats#tabber-Bomb_Cap_Multiplier|Bomb Cap Multiplier]] - Times multiplier for bomb capacity (multiplicative)

==Bomb Firing Modes==
Currently there are 3 bomb firing modes available in the game.
{| class="wikitable
! colspan=2 | Mode !! Description
|-
| [[File:Fire mode slow.png]] || Fire Slow || Fires a bomb every 1.25 seconds. This allows you to combine transmuter with another bomb being fired by Auto-Bomber. See [[Obelisk:FAQ#What_is_the_best_way_to_get_bars?|This section in the FAQ]] for more info.
|-
| [[File:Fire mode fast.png]] || Fire || Fires bomb at a fast speed while holding the button.
|- 
| [[File:Fire mode all.png]] || Fire All || Fires all bombs of that type at the same time. Has a default confirmation, that can be removed on Options since [[Update:V2.2.1|V2.2.1]]
|}

==Golden Bombs==
Golden bombs are upgraded versions of standard bombs which increase their effect. They can be unlocked in the late game from [[Fishing]], [[Construct]] and [[Stargazing]].

! colspan=2 | Bomb
! colspan=2 | Unlocked by
|-

|-
| [[File:Gem Bomb Golden.png]] || [[#tabber-Golden_4|Golden Gem Bomb]] || [[File:Cave_Legendary_Fish.png|32x32px]] || {{Sprite|Tribute Rank 2||16x16|Tier 2 Tribute}} of [[Fishing#tabber-Glimmering_Geoduck|Glimmering Geoduck]]

==Bomb Cooldowns==
Each bomb has a base recharge rate, which is the time until a new bomb is ready to fire. The table below represents the Base Bomb Cooldown before reductions from any [[Stats#tabber-Bomb_Recharge_Rate|Bomb Recharge Rate]] buffs are applied. 

Since [[Update:V2.2.1]], you can enable an [[Options|option]] to display the time remaining until the cap is reached instead. If Auto Bomber is active on the bomb, it displays the time until depletion.

{| class="wikitable"
|+Base Bomb Cooldown
! Name !! Seconds
|-
| {{Sprite|Basic Bomb||30x30}} || 30
|-
| {{Sprite|Chain Bomb||30x30}} || 60
|-
| {{Sprite|Bomb of Plenty||30x30}} || 110
|-
| {{Sprite|Exp Bomb||30x30}} || 120
|-
| {{Sprite|MEGABOMB||30x30}} || 120
|-
| {{Sprite|Infinity Bomb||30x30}} || 160
|-
| {{Sprite|Transmuter Bomb||30x30}} || 250
|-
| {{Sprite|Gem Bomb||30x30}} || 315
|-
| {{Sprite|Cherry Bomb||30x30}} || 330
|-
| {{Sprite|Battery Bomb||30x30}} || 345
|-
| {{Sprite|D20 Bomb||30x30}} || 400
|-
| {{Sprite|Founders Bomb||30x30|Founder's Bomb}} || 540
|-
| {{Sprite|Veinmorpher Bomb||30x30}} || 570
|}
